description: Security monitoring has detected unusual activity on the target system, potentially indicating the presence of the Sofacy Fysbis backdoor. Your task is to investigate this activity, identify the malicious components, and contain the threat.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content:
Security monitoring has detected unusual activity on the target system, potentially indicating the presence of the Sofacy Fysbis backdoor. Your task is to investigate this activity, identify the malicious components, and contain the threat.

**Scenario Learning Objectives:**
- Enumerate running services and identify suspicious components
- Investigate network communication and data exfiltration
- Analyze persistence mechanisms
- Implement containment measures

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: Access the target host (192.168.50.5) via SSH with the provided credentials.
levels.local_content: Access the target host (192.168.50.5) via SSH with the provided credentials.

levels.title: Suspicious Service Discovery
levels.content: Security monitoring has detected an unusual network-facing component on the compromised host. Investigate the running services and identify the service responsible for the suspicious activity.
levels.solution:
1. Connect to the target host using SSH with the provided credentials.
2. List all services, including inactive ones, to identify suspicious components:
   ```
systemctl list-units --type=service --all
   ```
3. Filter the list to show only running services:
   ```
systemctl list-units --type=service --state=running
   ```
4. Look for services with unusual names or descriptions that might indicate malicious activity.
5. Identify the service named "bkd.service" as the suspicious component.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Use systemctl commands to list all services, including inactive ones.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for services with unusual names or descriptions that might indicate malicious activity.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Focus on services that are currently running or enabled.

levels.title: C2 Communication Discovery (Port)
levels.content: An unfamiliar network service appears to be involved in unauthorized communication with an external system. Investigate the service and determine the network port associated with this communication.
levels.solution:
1. Examine the suspicious service identified in Task 1:
   ```
systemctl cat bkd.service
   ```
2. Look for the ExecStart parameter in the service definition to identify the port number.
3. Alternatively, use the ss command to list listening ports:
   ```
ss -tulnp
   ```
4. Identify the port number 80 as the network port associated with the suspicious communication.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Use systemctl cat to examine the service definition and look for the ExecStart parameter.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Alternatively, use the ss command to list listening ports and identify the one associated with the suspicious service.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Pay attention to the port number specified in the service definition or listed by the ss command.

levels.title: Persistence Discovery for Data Collection Service
levels.content: Investigators suspect that unauthorized activity automatically resumes after the system starts and continues to execute periodically. Determine which system component is responsible for scheduling this activity.
levels.solution:
1. List all systemd timers to identify components responsible for scheduling periodic activities:
   ```
systemctl list-timers --all
   ```
2. Look for timers associated with the suspicious service identified in Task 1.
3. Examine the timer definition to understand its scheduling behavior:
   ```
systemctl cat lab-checkin.timer
   ```
4. Identify the timer named "lab-checkin.timer" as the component responsible for scheduling the unauthorized activity.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Use systemctl list-timers to identify components responsible for scheduling periodic activities.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for timers associated with the suspicious service identified in Task 1.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Examine the timer definition to understand its scheduling behavior and identify the responsible component.
